text: It boots up affixed to the cold stone wall in a mess of wires and bramble.
The wires connect at the base of its limbs and the nape of its neck.
The wires and vines hold it in place awkwardly, itself dangling just a foot from the ground.
look: Despite this, it can see there is a steel door on the east side of the room and a hallway to the south.

transition: It rips away at the wires and vines that trap it against the wall. It tears with a fowl fury of long awaited rage.
At the climax of its aggression, it frees itself, falling to the cobblestone floor with a loud crash.
It stands up with time and now has a better view of the room.

text: The room is silent. The stone cold.
look: To the east is a large steel door with a padlock.
To the south is a deep hallway extending far past its vision.
To the west is the nest of wires and vines it was once a prisoner to.

choices.text: Move east towards the steel door
Move west to the wires and vines

text: A mass of tangled wires and vines dangle from off of the wall.
look: Upon closer inspection, after moving away several lingering strands, there appears to be a metal engraved plate against the wall.
The engravings are a series of numbers and letters. It reads:
